theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiNAB_innerAverage_tendsto_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (μ (Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) (reducedNormal μ ν x) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
